scope.claim: The pinned CN ConfigData contains source-native TrainingTech 223 explicitly related to NORMAL Soldier 115 and SP Soldier 5115; its listed LevelInfo records contain the corresponding NORMAL Description and SP SpSoidlierDescription raw strings.
admitted: Source-native IDs and explicit TrainingTech-to-soldier endpoints
Opaque NORMAL and SP Chinese description strings keyed by source LevelInfo ID

trainingTechLevelInfo.selection: Select only records whose numeric ID occurs in TrainingTech 223 TechLevelupInfoList; preserve ID, Description, and SpSoidlierDescription only.

normalTextField.meaning: Opaque source description string for the explicitly related NORMAL Soldier 115 text channel.

spTextField.meaning: Opaque source string used as SP Soldier 5115 description by the prior validated Legacy projection and stage contract; SP slot/application is not established.

trainingTechRelation.meaning: Explicit endpoint list [115,5115] on TrainingTech 223; endpoints are independently admitted Soldier identities.

levelInfoLink.meaning: Explicit list of source LevelInfo record IDs; no game level semantics asserted.

priorValidation.purpose: Narrow comparison of legacy text projection and source-field mapping; not independent evidence of game-level application.

validatedProjection.normalClaim: records[soldierId=115].ability.levels[levelInfoId].description equals ConfigDataTrainingTechLevelInfo#ID=<levelInfoId>/Description; Legacy output level is not admitted here.
validatedProjection.spClaim: records[soldierId=5115].sp.descriptionSourceTechId=223 and sp.descriptionLevels[levelInfoId].description equals ConfigDataTrainingTechLevelInfo#ID=<levelInfoId>/SpSoidlierDescription; Legacy output order/slot is not admitted here.

contract.limitation: Documents ordered descriptions on the primary TrainingTech path; does not establish actual SP slot or game application.

validation.limitation: Source description and relation coverage only; does not validate actual SP rank application.
